commit.message:
cipher: add dependency tracking to custom compile rules

* cipher/Makefile.am (custom_depflags, custom_depfile_o)
(custom_depfile_lo): New.
(tiger.o, tiger.lo): Use custom_depflags and custom_depfile_*.
(rijndael-aesni.o, rijndael-aesni.lo, rijndael-ssse3-amd64.o)
(rijndael-ssse3-amd64.lo, ...): Likewise.
--

Custom compile rules for modules with special compiler flags did not
generate dependency files, so changes to included headers did not
rebuild these modules. Generate dependency files in same way as
automake does for its own rules.

Signed-off-by: Jussi Kivilinna <jussi.kivilinna@iki.fi>
